title: The beta pitch talks about the Chatticus organization, not the organization computer
description:
The /beta hero currently leads with "The organization computer runs in an AWS account you own...". That is too narrow. The pitch should speak about the Chatticus organization / bot farm as a whole.

Lead with: **Your Chatticus organization runs in...** (same rest of the sentence: AWS account you own, on your network, under your logging, then the CloudFormation and IAM links).

Do not rename the product concept in Python, Gherkin about the actual computer, or `docs/ORGANIZATIONS.md`. This is marketing copy on the beta pitch.

DoD:
- `BetaAccessDisclosure` does not say "organization computer".
- It does say the Chatticus organization runs in the customer's AWS account.
- CloudFormation template and scoped IAM policy links stay.
- Gherkin on the beta funnel is updated; the old Then about "the organization computer" is gone from that feature.
- Home page / FAQ / product internals are out of scope unless they repeat this exact pitch line.

```gherkin
Feature: Beta waitlist marketing funnel

  Scenario: The access Chatticus needs is readable before signing up
    Given the beta pitch page
    Then it links to the cross-account CloudFormation template
    And it links to the scoped IAM policy
    And it states that the Chatticus organization runs in the customer AWS account
    And it does not call that deployment the organization computer
```
